stories.title: US strikes Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in first military action in weeks
stories.reason: US Central Command says it hit Iranian forces on Larak Island preparing to launch sea mines into the strait, breaking a month-long lull in the six-month war and prompting Iran to vow retaliation.

stories.title: Oil jumps, stock futures fall after US strike on Iran reignites Middle East tensions
stories.reason: Crude gained 2% and Dow futures slipped as traders priced in renewed escalation risk, compounding pressure from Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish rate-hike signals from last week.

stories.title: Supreme Court backs Trump's order to curb mail-in voting ahead of the midterms
stories.reason: The court let DHS begin compiling state voter-eligibility lists for now, a preliminary win for Trump that could reshape mail-ballot rules in Democratic-led states before November.

stories.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion of US goods take effect September 8
stories.reason: Carney says Canada will match US tariffs dollar-for-dollar after trade talks collapsed, escalating a fight that's already raising costs on steel, dairy, appliances and electronics.

stories.title: DARPA and the Air Force fly an AI-controlled F-16 fighter jet
stories.reason: An AI agent flew a modified operational-fleet F-16 under the VENOM program, showing ordinary combat aircraft -- not just experimental jets -- can be converted to autonomous control.

stories.title: Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis steps down as CEO to become chairman
stories.reason: Facing delayed models and departures, Google is putting Koray Kavukcuoglu in charge of daily operations while Hassabis shifts to long-term AI safety and governance work at Alphabet.

stories.title: Apple confirms September 9 event unveiling its first foldable iPhone
stories.reason: The book-style 'iPhone Ultra,' expected to start near $2,000, would be Apple's biggest hardware category bet in years as foldable phones go mainstream.

stories.title: Google rolls out 'Preferred Sources' button to help publishers hit by AI search traffic declines
stories.reason: With Google search traffic to publishers down roughly a third since AI Overviews rolled out, this embeddable button is Google's answer to mounting antitrust pressure and a wave of publisher revolt.
